comments.author: nuclearsandwich
comments.body:
> * rdl_release_team

Since rdl_release_team is redundant and will mess with some of the templating I'm fulfilling the request with `rdl` as the release team name.

comments.author: nuclearsandwich
comments.body: @jlack1987 can you please link an updated rosdistro PR which shows the rdl package source listing for a ROS 2 distro. It doesn't matter which ROS 2 distro you submit to and one is enough to cover release repository creation for all of them.

comments.author: nuclearsandwich
comments.body: #862 will resolve this request once the rosdistro source requirement is met.

comments.author: jlack1987
comments.body:
ok here's the link: https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/pull/47734

appreciate the help 🙏

comments.author: nuclearsandwich
comments.body: @jlack1987 this change has been merged and when deployed shortly you'll gain access to the release repository in the ros2-gbp organization. I have mirrored the existing release repository from https://github.com/jlack1987/rdl-release.git into the ros2-gbp organization and my recommendation is that you use the ros2-gbp repository for all new releases going forward. To ensure that you don't unintentionally use the original release repository I would suggest archiving it. This ensures that older references in ros/rosdistro can still access artifacts from it but that no new releases can be pushed to it by mistake.

comments.author: jlack1987
comments.body: Roger that it has been archived. Appreciate it 🙏
